t: When you ask for something in a bad moment
a: وَيَدْعُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ بِٱلشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُۥ بِٱلْخَيْرِ ۖ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَجُولًا
p: Wa yadʿu-l-insānu bi-sh-sharri duʿā'ahu bi-l-khayr, wa kāna-l-insānu ʿajūlā.
m: And man supplicates for evil [when angry] as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
